name: Panama City (Panama)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the arms of Panama City — a shield with a yoke and arrows, two caravels, a star and a border of castles and lions — beneath the words 'MUNICIPIO DE PANAMÁ' in red.
history: The city's arms were granted by Charles V on 15 September 1521, adopted by the municipality in 1909 and fixed in their present form by Resolution No. 66 of 1992. The white flag bearing them is used alongside a gonfalon; no adoption date has been published.

features.role: royal arms of Panama City granted 15 September 1521
